requirement: A site_brief row whose worker died with tracy-web while placing the words says what reached the site, and a second press does not write over it

oracle.ref: PR #1181 (fix); fix evidence: TCH #887: dev cowork.tracy.site 04/10/2026, e2e-jo.tracy.site — deploy #877 replaced tracy-web at 17:26:28Z during 'placing your text and pictures'; the row went failed with LOST_WORK at 17:30:30Z while /en/ already carried the customer's name, hero and services (qa/e2e-dev-2026-10-04, tasks/evidence/e2e-dev/2026-10-04/ F1).
oracle.invariant: 0 failures, 0 skipped. 'a worker that died while placing words that reached the site says they are partly in, not that none are' passes: a stale `applying` row with timings.applyIds settles as state `applied` with error LOST_PART ('…only part of them reached the site…'), keeps its applyIds, and a second start() of the same site answers {started: false} and calls neither prepare nor apply. 'a worker that died as placing began, before any write was kept, does not claim the site is untouched' passes: a stale `applying` row with no apply id settles `failed` with LOST_PLACING ('…may still have the template’s own words'). 'an open row whose worker died with the process is not held for ever' still passes: a stale `preparing` row settles `failed` with LOST_WORK. 'a worker that died after a write that reused an apply id says the words are partly in' passes: a stale `applying` row whose timings carry only reusedApplyIds ['dtrim-seed'] settles `applied` with LOST_PART (before review fix L1: `failed` with LOST_PLACING, which a second press would write over). Before the fix (brief-build.js gate at 77545996c7): every stale open row, `applying` included, settled `failed` with LOST_WORK ('the site has the template’s own words') — 2 failures in this file.
